verdict.rationale: Cooley documents a dedicated Cyber/Data/Privacy practice with nearly 100 lawyers counseling on privacy, cybersecurity and data protection, plus 400+ privacy due diligence reviews a year, so the core of the story is directly evidenced. The evidence never names the specific regimes the story lists (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP or local equivalents), so compliance-regime coverage is only implied. missing for 10: explicit evidence of GDPR/CCPA/DPDP or equivalent regulatory compliance counseling, detail on compliance-program services beyond due diligence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the privacy practice.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: Nearly 100 lawyers globally counseling on privacy, cybersecurity and data protection matters
400+ privacy and cybersecurity due diligence reviews conducted in the past year alone for M&A and investment transactions
